Feiruz

Overview

Feiruz is a thief who helps Kir conceal his conspicuous face beneath a cloth, using fear of disease as a disguise. Later he asks for help rescuing his fiancée Alia from prison. He dies during the escape, leaving Aliya grieving and determined to retaliate. [1, 2, 3]

Records and a new disguise

Rindeil suggests a poison that would change Kir’s skin colour but could cause paralysis; Karim offers a recipe that would take months. Neither solves the urgent problem. Feiruz proposes wrapping Kir’s face in cloth: survivors of a recent disease already conceal their disfigurement that way. Kir helps him with a theft to obtain the fabric, and Feiruz rewards his assistance. The disguise initially fools even Rindeil. It lets Kir move among the Khadaganians while continuing the search for another Joon. When Kel returns, she mocks the expensive cloth as an extravagant way to impersonate a poor survivor. She also warns that Rindeil’s promises of help are less reliable than his interest in spiders, and rejoins Kir to keep others from taking advantage of him. [4, 5, 1, 6, 7, 8]

The meteorite and Feiruz’s favour

Rindeil wants a meteorite sample brought from the lands the Khadaganians call useless. He has arranged to exchange it for a rare addition to his collection. Kir overhears the guards to locate the sample, but its locked chest calls for a better thief. Karim directs him to Feiruz at the Black Market. Kel challenges Feiruz’s pride until he agrees to help, on condition that they return the favour later. He opens the chest, earns Kel’s praise and leaves the party to rest. Rindeil rewards the delivery. The unpaid favour explains why Feiruz later expects help rescuing Aliya. [9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17]

Feiruz’s last rescue

Feiruz asks Kir to repay his help by rescuing his imprisoned fiancée Alia. He dies during the escape. Kel urges the grieving Aliya to avenge him and identifies the man who struck the fatal blow. Kir objects to deliberate revenge, but their companions insist on their code. The death of the prison commandant brings searches across the city. Fearing for his collection, Rindeil withdraws his protection, though he says Kir may return once the danger passes. Aliya then leads Kir and Kel to the Last Shelter and speaks for them before Brother Khatul. [2, 3, 18, 19, 20]
